checkpoint_count: 4 exclusive screening complexes per legacy carrier
methodological_rationale_and_testing_log: Establishes baseline weights in decision-tree and hybrid models. Because throughput at these specific queues directly maps to a single airline's flight banks, load factors, and delays, they provide the purest mathematical signal of schedule-driven volatility.
Represents standard cross-contaminated environments where multiple airlines' operational delays and bank peaks bleed into the same screening queue.

By training models to recognize volatility triggers at exclusive checkpoints and evaluating predictive accuracy on shared ones, the study proves the spatial generalizability and resilience of forecasting architectures in chaotic multi-carrier terminals.
